svg.aria-label: The lock-free read path: sealed segments are immutable, and the live tail is bounded by a published watermark, so readers and writers never block each other.
svg.title: The read path takes no locks
svg.desc: Sealed segments never change, so reading them needs no coordination. The live tail is the only mutable part: a writer appends past the watermark and publishes it only once the entry is whole, and a reader acquire-loads the watermark and reads everything before it.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The read path takes no locks

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Readers and writers never wait for each other. Most of that is free — the interesting part is the one piece that is still changing.

svg.text: ⚠ The ordering is the entire mechanism, and reversing it is invisible until it is not.

svg.text: Publish the watermark BEFORE the entry is complete and a reader can address half an entry — which no lock would have prevented either, because the reader

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: was told it was there. The window is short, so it survives testing and appears under load.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A watermark means a stable PREFIX, so entries must be published in order — a gap would make everything after it visible early.
